notes: Predictions are stored model outputs; injuries and weather are not included.
Source B native slots have unverified selection mapping.
Settlement SP is not historical prematch odds.
History is limited to sampled team history, not the full database.
Observed odds after the prediction cutoff must be excluded.
Pending conflicts and unverified empty dates are not resolved by this sync.

recent_repair.note: 完成仅指重查现有来源近30天；空返回不证明没有比赛，未覆盖的正式比赛仍需独立来源核实。

paper.rule: first fresh observation 3h to 2h before stored sales cutoff; no retrospective enrolment; all eligible matches, no bets

limitations: Coverage checks cannot establish a complete real-world schedule without independent fixtures.
Large market disagreement is a diagnostic flag, not a betting edge.
Local first-enrolment ledger preserves observations; old GitHub commits provide additional history.
No model retraining or probability adjustment performed.
Recent team counts combine confirmed aliases; source coverage remains unverified.
